headline: Executive order signed March 31, 2025, directs federal action against unfair practices in the live entertainment market.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order targets practices the administration considers unfair in live entertainment, such as concerts and other live events. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires, and which agencies must carry them out, are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People who buy tickets to concerts, sports, and other live events
who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at practices in the market where they buy tickets, though the specific effects are not described in the available material.

who_it_affects.group: Ticket sellers, resellers, and live event companies
who_it_affects.how: Their business practices appear to be the focus of the order, but the specific rules or actions are not stated in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 31, 2025; executive orders usually take effect when signed, though any agency actions may come later.
